subject: NimbusAI -> Redwood: technical handoff window for switchover
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@NimbusAI.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Moore <dan.moore@NimbusAI.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: architecture deep-dive for switchover to Redwood

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the pilot call last week. Nimbus is aiming to begin a staged switchover from our current self-hosted inference rig to Redwood for a small set of production traffic starting mid July. Before we push any traffic over we need a technical deep-dive with your infra/ops/arch folks to align on the migration plan and cutover windows.

High-level asks for the session:
- Walkthrough of how KV caching and prefix cache will behave during initial sync
- Model variant recommendations and quantization impacts on latency
- Expected peak QPS and throttling behavior; P95/P99 targets we can expect
- Network/egress patterns for VPC deployment and any firewall rules we need to open
- Rollback/fallback mechanics if we hit regressions after switchover

Can you share 2 x 60–90min slots next week that include at least one person from your runtime/ops and one from security/compliance? We have attached a short migration requirements spreadsheet (nimbus_migration_requirements.xlsx) with our model sizes, typical request shape, and current KV cache config.

Thanks — looking to lock this in early so our SREs can free up time.

— Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, NimbusAI
priya@NimbusAI.com

Attachment: nimbus_migration_requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Priya —

Appreciate the detail. We can definitely run the deep-dive and will include runtime, ops, and a security engineer. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-07-07 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-07-08 14:00–15:30

Draft agenda (60–90m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Current Nimbus setup recap (you) + quick Q&A (10m)
3) Redwood runtime/serving architecture overview (15m)
4) KV/prefix caching and transition plan (15m)
5) Performance expectations & load shaping (10m)
6) Security/VPC/network checklist (10m)
7) Rollout cadence, smoke tests, rollback plan & open actions (10–20m)

Before the session please share: perf traces (P95/P99) for a 24h window, a sample inference request payload, and the model artifact size. If you can drop those into the Drive folder linked below, that’ll speed the cadence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nimbus-onboard

Looping in Laura (ops) who will own runbook coordination and meeting logistics.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
